text:
Zara (CS): NimbusRx preflight call tomorrow 8:30am PT. Account health = amber (trial active, churn signal from low success rate). Renewal ~33 days. They see slow cold-start first-token latency after idle. Need a short customer-facing runbook (warmup, prefix cache, batching profile, streaming fallback) + who collects feedback post-call.

Ethan (Eng): Minimal tech plan: 1) enable prefix caching for top-5 prompts, TTL=9m; 2) continuous batching target 20-28ms, max batch 14; 3) streaming enabled with chunk_size=256 and streaming_fallback=chunked. Recommend synthetic warmup 25m before with 30 parallel prefill requests to stabilize KV cache. Sample warmup curl: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route/nimbus-prod/warmup \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<warmup sample>"}' &
```

Maya (SRE): SRE constraints: route timeout 6s, error budget SLO route_errors < 3% over 5m. Add Prom alert: `redwood_route_errors{route=\"nimbus-prod\"} > 3% for 3m`. Pager if p95 latency > 1000ms for 4m. Add canary route `nimbus-prod-canary` that flips if median(latency) > 700ms.

Rahul (PM): I'll own the customer-facing checklist and feedback capture. Post-call we'll send a 3-question form (latency ok? quality ok? anything blocking?) and record sentiment in CRM. I'll create a GH issue and tag renewal-risk if negative.

Zara (CS): Can WarmupBot schedule the warmup and capture first-token latency samples to show the customer improvement live? Also confirm recommended KV cache size for private deploy.

WarmupBot: Warmup scheduled by Ethan: id=wm-1789012345, run_at=2026-08-05T08:05:00Z, concurrency=30, route=nimbus-prod. Logs saved to /warmups/wm-1789012345. :white_check_mark:

Ethan (Eng): For private deploys recommend KV cache 640MB and quantized int8 model when acceptable. Hosted: prefer reserved r5 serving profile during the 30m window. Set max_async_prefill=48.

Maya (SRE): I'll add the alert to the SRE runbook and create a short pager play: if p95>1000ms -> flip to canary, if errors>5% -> rollback traffic and notify CS.

Zara (CS): Action recap: Rahul creates checklist + feedback form, Maya adds alerts & pager play, Ethan posts final config and schedules warmup, Zara will run preflight checklist 15m prior and paste the customer-facing script here.

Rahul (PM): On it, I'll attach the feedback form link after the call and update CRM with sentiment.

Zara (CS): Thanks team — I'll paste the 15-min preflight steps in here later today so support can rehearse.
